t: This is the Marlborough Theatre in Holloway, in Islington, a former theatre and cinema. It was designed by Frank Matcham, the English theatre architect who specialised in theatres and music halls. Over a forty-year career he was responsible for designing and building more than ninety theatres, and remodelling around eighty more. In London his name is on the Hippodrome, Hackney Empire, Shepherd's Bush Empire, the Coliseum and the Palladium. This is one of the many entertainment buildings he left across the city.
